description: Unpowered, foot-launched glider with a flexible fabric wing hung on lines. A powered paraglider is in Vehicles.
Canopy, container and harness system for descending from an aircraft, including skydiving rigs.
Clothing made for dance practice rather than everyday wear. Everyday dance-style clothing is in Clothing.
Blank-firing pistol made to start races. One made for self-defence is in Weapons & Armour.
Sit harness with leg loops and a belay loop that ties the climber into the rope; the UIAA or EN standard is noted where it is met.
Magnetic compass made for finding your way on foot (baseplate, thumb or sighting compass). A drawing compass is in Office & Stationery.
Replica gun that fires plastic BB pellets by spring, gas or electric power, made for airsoft play.
Cutting and thrusting fencing weapon with a knuckle guard, made to FIE rules. The sabre sword is in Weapons & Armour.
Mesh mask with a bib that protects a fencer's face, head and neck; the FIE 1600 N bib is noted where it is met.
Heavy cotton jacket and trousers made for judo grips and throws.
Blunt or unsharpened wushu sword, broadsword, staff or spear made for practice or competition.
Blunt steel or synthetic sword made for sparring and drills in historical European martial arts (HEMA).
Padded jacket made for HEMA, rated to a puncture resistance such as 350 N or 800 N where certified.
Padded or plated gloves that protect the hands from sword blows in HEMA sparring.
Stiff-soled shoe made for cycling, usually with a cleat fitting for clipless pedals.
Helmet made for horse riding, certified to an equestrian helmet standard.
Goggles made for skiing and snowboarding against glare, wind and snow.
Helmet made for skiing and snowboarding.
Ski made for downhill skiing with a fixed-heel binding; use class, width and turning radius vary.
Rigid plastic-shell boot made to drive an alpine or touring ski through the binding; stiffness is rated on the maker's scale.
Light ski made for climbing with skins and then skiing down, used with a touring binding and boot.
Bag that carries one pair of skis. A bag for several pieces is in Bags & Accessories.
Flat-faced willow bat made for cricket; willow grade 1 to 4 is a retailer convention.
Inflated ball made for association football; comes in sizes.
Oval inflated ball made for rugby; comes in official-ball classes and sizes.
Racing suit made for competitive swimming. Bikinis, trunks and beachwear are in Clothing.
Watertight goggles made for swimming.
Pyrotechnic flare that signals distress by light or smoke.
Bag that carries one set of golf clubs.
Rubber sheet, with or without sponge, glued to a table tennis bat; the surface is inverted, pimples-out or long pimples.
Unpowered sled or toboggan ridden downhill on snow or ice for play or sport. A horse-drawn or machine-drawn sleigh is in Vehicles.
Rounded bat made for baseball or softball; comes in hard-ball and soft-ball types and in different materials.
Studded or bladed boot made for football; the ground type it suits (FG, AG, SG, MG, TF, IC) is marked on it.
Unpowered scooter with a deck and handlebar, pushed along by foot. A powered kick scooter is in Vehicles.
Unpowered board on two trucks and four wheels, ridden standing. A powered board is in Vehicles.
Unpowered single-wheel cycle pedalled and balanced by the rider. An electric unicycle is in Vehicles.
Neoprene suit that insulates the wearer in water, for surfing, diving, triathlon and paddling; comes in different thicknesses.
Pistol made to fire distress or signal flares.
Case or cover that holds one racket.
Flexible rod made to cast and play a fish on a line; comes in different powers and actions.
Model or replica of a bird or animal set out to lure game within range.
Device blown, struck or played electronically that imitates an animal's sound to attract game.
Snare, leg-hold or body-grip trap made for trapping game or fur animals. Mouse, rat, insect and live-catch cage traps are in Home Safety & Security.
Portable hide or screen that conceals a hunter from game.
Handheld laser rangefinder made to measure the distance to game.
Boss, butt or block made to stop arrows, with or without a target face.
Guard strapped to the bow arm that protects it from the bowstring.
Leather or synthetic pad worn on the drawing fingers to hold and release the string.
Curved throwing wing made to return to the thrower or fly for distance, in every form.
Matched set of irons of graded loft with flat-faced heads; the type is game improvement, players distance or blade.
Handheld laser rangefinder made to measure the distance to the flag. Golf GPS units are in Phones, Tablets & Personal Devices.
Stationary pedal machine with an upright seat and handlebar, the standard exercise bike; the resistance type varies.
Stationary bike with a heavy front flywheel and a road-bike riding position that allows riding out of the saddle.
Stationary bike with a seat with a backrest and the pedals set forward.
Small trampoline (rebounder) with a frame of about 1.2 m or less, sold for exercise. A garden or play trampoline is in Toys & Games.
Machine with a moving belt for walking or running in place; the belt is motorised or manual.
Insulated bag to sleep in outdoors; it carries a season or temperature rating.
Portable fabric shelter pitched on poles or frames, including yurts and tipis. A platform built for one is in Property & Structures.
Adjustable walking pole used for support on trails; the grip is I-type, T-type or Nordic.
Light, long-shafted racket strung for badminton; balance, weight and flex vary.
Wooden blade, with or without rubbers, used to hit the ball in table tennis; the grip is shakehand or penholder.
Regulation-surface table with a net made for table tennis; indoor or outdoor models.
Felt-covered rubber ball made for tennis; pressurised or pressureless.
Strung racket made for tennis; head size, weight and balance vary.
Court shoe sold as a performance model with a court-specific sole for tennis. An everyday tennis-style sneaker is in Footwear.
Solid, stringless perforated racket made for padel.
Pressurised felt ball made for padel, slightly less pressurised than a tennis ball.
Solid, flat-faced paddle made for pickleball.
Perforated plastic ball made for pickleball.
Single high or training bar on uprights for swings and release moves; a kids' single training bar counts here too.
Padded trousers or breeches made for HEMA sparring, with a puncture rating where given.
Suspended fabric bed hung between trees for sleeping outdoors. A garden hammock is not in this category.
40 mm celluloid-free plastic ball made for table tennis; comes with a star rating.
Cover or case that holds one padel racket.
Court shoe sold as a performance model with a pickleball-specific sole. An everyday sneaker is in Footwear.
Long-shafted stick with a flat blade, made to carry and shoot the puck in ice hockey; flex, kick point, blade pattern and hand vary.
